criteria.requirement: Fix Table.join right-key resolution for positional and mixed composite identifiers, including negative column indices, and prevent equal-valued right columns from causing the wrong key column to be omitted. Preserve name keys, callable keys, explicit columns, unmatched/required matching and full_outer behavior. Preserve all public-contract compatibility controls and pass the complete frozen upstream suite.

Deliver a real implementation change only within the two authorized paths. Do not modify original tests, dependencies, test configuration, locale data or protected verification. Cite actual implementation evidence.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests in the authorized new test file that fail on the pinned original and pass after the implementation. Cover the public normal and boundary cases; protected controller verification does not replace delivered tests.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct implementations and evidence grounded in the public contract; do not match wording or a reference patch.
